Integration Goal: Make failures observable and ensure stable fallback to available models
Key Gap/Risk: Friday attempt logs lack reason/status/code and have no auth-profile cooldown granularity
Minimal Change Action: Extend FridayProviderAttempt fields and introduce profile-level cooldown/skip
Acceptance Criteria (Automation First): Inject 429/503/timeout and assert attempts include reason/status/code with ordered fallback

Integration Goal: After user selection, primary model must not silently drift to local model
Key Gap/Risk: Budget strategy may force-switch to ollama and cause model drift
Minimal Change Action: Add routing.enforceRequestedModel switch and persist providerId/model
Acceptance Criteria (Automation First): After setting ChatGPT as primary model and restart, actualModel stays equal to user selection

Integration Goal: Runtime must use one config source only to avoid drift
Key Gap/Risk: Friday currently has dual sources: config.channels and friday_setup_state
Minimal Change Action: Unify to a single source of truth and remove fallback branch (keep the other as read-only cache)
Acceptance Criteria (Automation First): After editing either config and restarting, hash stays stable with no reverse overwrite

Integration Goal: Support debounced/preflighted/stable inbound handling under burst traffic
Key Gap/Risk: Friday direct callback path lacks debounce/preflight and can jitter on bursts
Minimal Change Action: Move Discord inbound to dedicated handler: debounce -> preflight -> process
Acceptance Criteria (Automation First): Under 20 messages in 2 seconds, pipeline triggers one controlled batch or bounded batching

Integration Goal: Typing indicator should be accurate during reply and stop promptly
Key Gap/Risk: Current global pulse is coarse and not channel-lifecycle aware
Minimal Change Action: Switch to dispatch-lifecycle typing callbacks while keeping pulse fallback
Acceptance Criteria (Automation First): When model reply takes >2s, Discord shows continuous typing and stops immediately on completion

Integration Goal: Ensure context truly enters model with correct thread semantics
Key Gap/Risk: Friday has basic history replay but lacks thread/reply-level context packaging
Minimal Change Action: Inject thread/reply metadata into session key and history packer
Acceptance Criteria (Automation First): Follow-up inside thread hits thread-local history instead of noisy channel-wide history

Integration Goal: Prevent verbal claims of execution and enforce tool_result integrity
Key Gap/Risk: Friday only adds completion-claim text warning; no transcript-level tool_result repair
Minimal Change Action: Add tool_result guard (missing-result synthesis, oversize truncation, persistence consistency)
Acceptance Criteria (Automation First): When tool_result is intentionally dropped, transcript auto-repairs and run continues

Integration Goal: Block all side-effect browser acts in readOnly runs
Key Gap/Risk: Classifier reads args.action only and misses action=act + act=click/type cases
Minimal Change Action: Fix classifier to inspect args.act when action=act
Acceptance Criteria (Automation First): In readOnly mode, browser act click/type are consistently blocked

Integration Goal: Support user-visible browser control, not only headless sessions
Key Gap/Risk: Friday defaults to headless; actions execute but are not visible to users
Minimal Change Action: Add host browser bridge/relay mode with profile selection
Acceptance Criteria (Automation First): When user asks "open Google" in Discord, host-visible tab opens

Integration Goal: Desktop capability must be truly callable at runtime
Key Gap/Risk: desktop tool appears only if desktopSessionManager is injected; bootstrap currently does not inject it
Minimal Change Action: Create and inject createDesktopSessionManager in hub bootstrap
Acceptance Criteria (Automation First): After startup, tool list contains desktop and baseline actions succeed

Integration Goal: gateway tool should return real status instead of default not-configured stubs
Key Gap/Risk: Friday gateway is currently graceful-degradation stub and often returns not configured
Friday has provider-level usage but lacks sessions.usage view
Acceptance Criteria (Automation First): Specified Discord session returns total tokens and time series

Integration Goal: Make both auto-extraction and user-triggered extraction available
Key Gap/Risk: Friday mostly depends on background jobs and lacks explicit user-triggered checkpoint extraction
Minimal Change Action: Add sessions.memory.extract action with rate limiting
Acceptance Criteria (Automation First): Manual trigger creates memory items and marks message status as extracted

Integration Goal: Keep plaintext-secret blocking and capability matrix enforcement
Key Gap/Risk: This is mostly closed; main risk is regression
Minimal Change Action: Keep strict default and add plaintext-secret regression checks in CI
Acceptance Criteria (Automation First): In strict mode, raw token is rejected while secret://channel reference passes

Key Gap/Risk: Asset classification exists; policy control must remain explicit
Minimal Change Action: Keep agent install switch aligned with runbook policy

Integration Goal: Allow free and one-time purchase only (MVP)
Key Gap/Risk: Backend restriction is in place; frontend/DTO may still expose non-MVP fields
Minimal Change Action: Filter subscription/usage_based at API DTO/UI layers as well

Key Gap/Risk: Friday currently uses fixed session key pattern and lacks binding-based routing layer
Minimal Change Action: Add bindings table and route resolver before executeRun
Acceptance Criteria (Automation First): Two Discord channels route consistently to two different agents

Integration Goal: Turn duplicate-callback defense and staging rollback drill into hard release gates
Key Gap/Risk: Capabilities are implemented; risk is lack of enforcement in release process
Minimal Change Action: Make rollback drill evidence a required release CI artifact
Acceptance Criteria (Automation First): Before each release, auto-generate drill evidence markdown and attach to PR

Integration Goal: After boot, run only one runtime stack with stable model/channel alignment
Key Gap/Risk: Script exists but is not yet default operational entrypoint
Minimal Change Action: Integrate converge script into runbook and startup health checks
Acceptance Criteria (Automation First): After cold boot, channels auto-connect and primary model does not drift
